requirements.condition: When generating a stateless reset token.
requirements.required_behavior: Generate a stateless reset token that is difficult to guess.
requirements.why_checkable: The token-generation implementation and statistical or cryptographic properties of generated tokens can be tested for predictability.

requirements.quote:
output of this function is truncated to 16 bytes to produce the

requirements.condition: When the described static-key pseudorandom-function method is used to derive a stateless reset token.
requirements.required_behavior: Truncate the function output to 16 bytes to form the connection's stateless reset token.
requirements.why_checkable: Tests can invoke the derivation method and verify that its resulting stateless reset token is exactly 16 bytes.

requirements.condition: When an endpoint uses the stateless-reset design that recovers the connection ID from received packets without retained connection state.
requirements.required_behavior: Either use one connection ID length for all connections or encode the connection ID length so it can be recovered without state.
requirements.why_checkable: The endpoint's issued connection IDs and stateless recovery logic can be inspected or tested to verify one of the two permitted length-handling strategies.

requirements.quote:
Revealing the stateless reset token allows any entity to terminate
   the connection, so a value can only be used once.  This method for
requirements.condition: When selecting or revealing a stateless reset token value.
requirements.required_behavior: Use each stateless reset token value only once.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Reuse a stateless reset token value after it has been used.
requirements.why_checkable: Token assignment and revelation history can be tracked to detect reuse of a value.

requirements.quote:
choosing the stateless reset token means that the combination of
   connection ID and static key MUST NOT be used for another connection.
requirements.condition: When the described static-key method is used to choose stateless reset tokens.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Use the same combination of connection ID and static key for another connection.
requirements.why_checkable: Connection creation records can be checked for repeated connection-ID/static-key pairs across distinct connections.

requirements.quote:
that is reset by revealing the stateless reset token MUST NOT be
   reused for new connections at nodes that share a static key.
requirements.condition: After a connection has been reset by revealing its stateless reset token, at nodes that share the relevant static key.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Reuse that connection's connection ID for a new connection.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can reveal a token to reset a connection and then verify that nodes sharing the static key never assign its connection ID to later connections.

requirements.quote:

requirements.condition: When assigning stateless reset tokens to connection IDs.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Use the same stateless reset token for multiple connection IDs.
requirements.why_checkable: Token assignments can be compared to verify that no token maps to more than one connection ID.

requirements.condition: When an endpoint detects a duplicate stateless reset token value.
